title: Transport multiple objects one at a time between locations
description: Use this when a task requires moving multiple objects from one location to another.
content: Pick up one object, navigate to the destination, and place it there before returning to fetch the next object; repeat this cycle until all required objects have been moved.

title: Pick up the object before navigating to the destination
description: Use this when you need to transport an object from one location to another.
content: Once the target object is located, take it immediately to add it to your inventory. Then navigate to the destination location and use the move action to place the object there.

title: Search common surfaces before opening storage containers
description: Use this when looking for small portable objects like watches that are not immediately visible.
content: When searching for target objects, first check open surfaces such as tables and countertops, because objects placed there are directly visible and can be picked up without needing to open drawers or other closed containers.

title: Search for target objects on countertops before checking cabinets
description: Use this when looking for a mug or similar everyday object that is not found inside closed storage.
content: When searching for a mug, first check open surfaces such as countertops, since mugs are often placed there rather than inside cabinets. If cabinets are empty after opening, pivot to checking countertops and other visible surfaces before continuing to search enclosed storage.

title: Search multiple cabinets before assuming an item is absent
description: Use when looking for a target object that may be stored in any of several closed containers.
content: When searching for an object like a mug, systematically check multiple cabinets and countertops rather than stopping after the first empty or irrelevant container. The target object may be located on a countertop rather than inside a cabinet.

title: Locate target objects by searching alternative containers and surfaces
description: Use this when the required objects are not found on the initially examined surface or container.
content: When a target object is not present at the expected location, systematically examine nearby containers and then visit other plausible locations such as shelves to find the required items.

title: Verify container contents before assuming an object is inside
description: Use this when searching closed containers such as drawers for target objects.
content: Opening a closed container reveals its contents; if the target object is not inside, move on to other locations rather than spending additional actions on that container.

description: Use this when moving multiple objects to confirm progress and avoid losing track of completed placements.
content: After placing an object at the destination, check the destination's contents to confirm the object is present before going back to retrieve the next required object.

title: Clean items at a sinkbasin
description: Use this when a task requires cleaning a food item or object.
content: Navigate to a sinkbasin and use the "clean [item] with [sinkbasin]" action to wash the item. The sinkbasin may have other objects on it, but those do not interfere with the cleaning action.
